```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Rendered from the project root (see the Snakefile `report` rule), so all paths are root-relative.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(yaml)
library(knitr)

cfg <- read_yaml(params$config)
res <- function(f) file.path(cfg$results_dir, f)
fig <- function(f) normalizePath(file.path(cfg$plots_dir, f))   # absolute: embedded by pandoc
show_fig <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(cfg$plots_dir, f))) include_graphics(fig(f), rel_path = FALSE) else
  cat("*Figure not produced in this run.*")

summ <- read.csv(res("run_summary.csv"))
S <- setNames(summ$value, summ$key)
tt <- read.csv(res("ACT_vs_Sham_limma_all.csv"))
de <- read.csv(res("ACT_vs_Sham_limma_DE.csv"))

fmt_p <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2)
sig_label <- if (S["sig_col"] == "adj.P.Val") "BH FDR" else "unadjusted P"
```

# Design

- **Tissue / model:** mouse hippocampus; ACT = doxorubicin + cyclophosphamide + paclitaxel.
- **Contrast:** ACT vs Sham, n = 4 per group. Positive log2FC = higher in ACT. MnBuOE groups are
  excluded on purpose (chemotherapy effect only).
- **Input:** raw MaxQuant iBAQ from Table S1 (`r S["proteins_input"]` protein groups). Authors' normalized
  values and statistics are not used.

# Methods

| Step | Setting |
|---|---|
| Missing values | iBAQ = 0 treated as missing |
| Filter | ≥ `r cfg$preprocessing$min_valid_per_group` valid values in at least one group → `r S["proteins_filtered"]` proteins |
| Transformation / normalization | log2, median centering per sample |
| Imputation | MinProb-like: N(mean − `r cfg$preprocessing$impute_shift` SD, `r cfg$preprocessing$impute_width` SD) per sample, seed `r cfg$seed` |
| Model | limma `~ 0 + group + batch` (batch = replicate pair 1–2 vs 3–4), `eBayes(trend = TRUE)` |
| Significance | BH FDR < `r cfg$de$fdr_cutoff`; if nothing passes, unadjusted P < `r cfg$de$nominal_cutoff`; always \|log2FC\| > `r cfg$de$logfc_cutoff` |
| Sensitivity | same model without imputation (limma handles NAs) |
| Enrichment | GSEA (GO ALL, KEGG) on signed −log10(P); ORA (GO BP) of up/down sets vs the identified proteome; gene sets `r cfg$enrichment$min_gs_size`–`r cfg$enrichment$max_gs_size`, adj. P < `r cfg$enrichment$pvalue_cutoff` |

# Quality control

**Missing values per sample:** `r S["missing_per_sample"]`.

**Variance explained by the PCs:** `r S["pca_var_explained"]`. Replicates 1–2 and 3–4 differ in depth;
the replicate pair is modeled as a batch factor.

```{r, out.width = "70%"}
show_fig("pca.png")
```

```{r, out.width = "48%", fig.show = "hold"}
show_fig("density_preprocessing.png")
show_fig("boxplot_normalized.png")
```

# Differential abundance

**Criterion used in this run:** `r sig_label` < `r S["sig_cutoff"]` and |log2FC| > `r S["logfc_cutoff"]`
→ **`r S["n_up"]` up** and **`r S["n_down"]` down** in ACT
(`r sum(tt$adj.P.Val < cfg$de$fdr_cutoff)` proteins pass FDR < `r cfg$de$fdr_cutoff` without the fold-change filter).

```{r, out.width = "80%"}
show_fig("volcano.png")
```

```{r, out.width = "60%"}
show_fig("heatmap_DE.png")
```

## Differentially abundant proteins

`robust` = the call holds in the analysis without imputation (same direction and cutoffs).
`miss Sham` / `miss ACT` = replicates without a quantification (imputed values).

```{r}
de_tab <- de[order(-de$robust_noimp, de$status, de$P.Value),
             c("SYMBOL", "protein_name", "status", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val",
               "noimp_logFC", "noimp_P.Value", "n_missing_Sham", "n_missing_ACT", "robust_noimp")]
de_tab$protein_name <- substr(de_tab$protein_name, 1, 45)
de_tab[, c("P.Value", "adj.P.Val", "noimp_P.Value")] <-
  lapply(de_tab[, c("P.Value", "adj.P.Val", "noimp_P.Value")], fmt_p)
kable(de_tab, row.names = FALSE, digits = 2,
      col.names = c("Symbol", "Protein", "Status", "log2FC", "P", "FDR", "log2FC (no imp.)",
                    "P (no imp.)", "miss Sham", "miss ACT", "robust"))
```

## Sensitivity to imputation

`r S["n_robust_noimp"]` of `r as.integer(S["n_up"]) + as.integer(S["n_down"])` calls are robust without
imputation; correlation of log2FC with vs without imputation: r = `r S["cor_logfc_imp_noimp"]`.
Calls that depend on imputation are usually presence/absence patterns (protein missing in most replicates of
one group) rather than quantitative changes.

```{r, out.width = "75%"}
show_fig("sensitivity_imputation_logFC.png")
```

# Enrichment

## GSEA — GO

`r S["n_gsea_go"]` GO terms with adj. P < `r cfg$enrichment$pvalue_cutoff`. NES > 0 = enriched among proteins
higher in ACT.

```{r}
top_terms <- function(file, n = 15) {
  if (!file.exists(res(file))) return(cat("*Not available in this run.*"))
  g <- read.csv(res(file))
  if (nrow(g) == 0) return(cat("*No significant terms.*"))
  g <- g[order(g$p.adjust), ]
  out <- rbind(head(g[g$NES > 0, ], n), head(g[g$NES < 0, ], n))
  cols <- intersect(c("ONTOLOGY", "Description", "setSize", "NES", "p.adjust"), names(out))
  out$p.adjust <- fmt_p(out$p.adjust)
  kable(out[, cols], row.names = FALSE, digits = 2)
}
top_terms("gsea_GO.csv")
```

```{r, out.width = "90%"}
show_fig("gsea_GO_dotplot.png")
```

```{r, out.width = "48%", fig.show = "hold"}

show_fig("gsea_GO_emapplot.png")
```

## ORA — GO BP (up / down sets)

```{r}
if (file.exists(res("ora_GO_BP_up_down.csv")) && as.integer(S["n_ora"]) > 0) {
  o <- read.csv(res("ora_GO_BP_up_down.csv"))
  o$p.adjust <- fmt_p(o$p.adjust)
  kable(head(o[order(o$Cluster, o$p.adjust), c("Cluster", "Description", "GeneRatio", "p.adjust", "geneID")], 30),
        row.names = FALSE)
} else cat("*No significant terms for the up/down sets (few proteins against a background of the whole identified proteome).*")
```
